text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Happy New Year,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And... I am truly, deeply sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the auspicious sunrise,
what in the world had just happened—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again this year, we ended up going
to that beautiful coast to watch the sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cesario sits in the passenger seat. She prepared a lot of things for the trip, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Would you like... some tea?
I thought you might be getting sleepy soon...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: We also have... sweets you... might like...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...*breathe in*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the swaying of the car acted as a cradle,
for halfway through the journey, she had fallen fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You must have been tired too, Trainer, and yet I went and fell fast asleep right next to you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If anything, my heart leapt at the feeling that they were opening up to me."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...Truth be told, I also feel a bit frustrated. We had such a great drive planned, so it feels like a waste..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"There was something
I wanted your advice on as well."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's regarding Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't figure out...
how she produced that special something
I felt during the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I would like to ask for your opinion, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try to trace the memories of that day once again.
Air Messiah's figure and the surrounding situation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Unfortunately, however, I still couldn't
come up with anything that felt like an answer."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right. If you have time today,
would you like to meet with Messiah?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Or we could sniff around for rumors about her from Tracen Academy and race fans."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: In other words, I figured we might as well just go hear their raw opinions directly!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... of course,
that is, if you're not too tired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Strangely enough, my body felt energized. Now then, what should I do next today—
choice_data_list: Head into town to investigate the rumors
Ask for opinions at the academy

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit...!
I'll try contacting them right away!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Cesario-san, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I apologize for intruding so early in the new year.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'd like to extend New Year's greetings and ask about the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: R... 'radiance', you say...? Coming from me...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is why I was hoping to ask
a bit about how you felt on the day of the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho was... well, as you probably
already know, Cesario-san, I was just completely
desperate through and through."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Because up until that day,
I hadn't run a single race that I was truly satisfied with."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The only thing I desired was 'victory'—
that was truly the only mindset I held."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, just remembering it brings tears to my eyes too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Even from a parent's perspective, she was working so hard. And the excitement in the stands was incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: M-Mother...! I'm happy, but, um... we're in front of my friend...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, no.
Please, I would love to hear your story.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Really? Let's see then, how about we start with the phone call before the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After listening to her story for a bit,
having some tea, and making small talk...
I left Air Messiah's family home.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Messiah-san, you're really close
with your mother, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It was enough to warm the hearts
of anyone listening.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, we weren't able to hear anything
that gave us a definitive answer about that 'brilliance'..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that they weren't aware of it themselves
either...? Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The more I think about it, the more it feels like the answer is slipping away.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Yeah.
I'm sorry, shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sorry for keeping you going without a break since morning.
You must be tired too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Let's head back and relax.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we returned to the Trainer's Room for the day,
leisurely eating mochi while watching the ekiden—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! In that case, first...
Shall we check out the shopping street?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I visited the shopping district, expecting it
to be bustling today, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: W-What a huge crowd...! As expected of New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The staff seem quite busy.
It looks like we won't be able to talk to them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And the moment I let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario was swept away
by the crowd—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, huh!?
T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye,
they were completely out of sight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My smartphone was dropped back there too, leaving me with no way to contact anyone. The only option left was—
choice_data_list: (I'll have to rely on instinct to find it...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Cesario
is thinking the exact same thing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing that, I hurry toward a place she'd likely
choose as a meeting spot—somewhere not too far,
with few people and buildings—and find—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me—oh, thank goodness...!
I had a feeling you'd be here, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I was just thinking the same thing!
I was just thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Truly?
Hehe, that's kind of amazing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It seems I can only use telepathy with Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, do you know
what I'm thinking about right now?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went all the way to the beach this morning, then came
right back near Tracen Academy, and on top of that got swept up
in a crowd. If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Feel like taking it easy for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, amazing, that's correct!
...Maybe you really can use telepathy after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we returned to the Trainer's Room for the day,
leisurely eating mochi while watching the ekiden—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
It looks like it might be a bit lively around this time of year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, upon returning to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the academy, a mochi-pounding event was taking place. The one running it was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's Vodka, who loves anything cool and full of energy, and
Daiwa Scarlet, an honor student who hates to lose.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Cesario! We just finished making it.
You guys should have some too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Here're your toppings.
I recommend my special chili sugar soy sauce!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I was gonna make it crazy spicy,
but eh, I went easy on ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Just kidding! The truth is, I make it sweet because I can't eat it otherwise."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah!?
N-No way! Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah.
And... here, the ingredients you were looking for earlier!
I'll leave them over there."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, thanks...!
How'd you know I was looking for that...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's just that you're so easy to read.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Here, not really as thanks or anything, but take this!
You're thirsty, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-Well, a little bit...! Since you went through the trouble, I suppose I'll take it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: They're just like an old married couple, aren't they...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: H-Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the academy is bustling with the mochi-pounding
event. The atmosphere isn't quite right for having
a calm, serious conversation...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we give up for today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we returned to the Trainer's Room for the day,
leisurely eating mochi while watching the ekiden—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: This university is strong again this year, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We enjoyed a nice, leisurely New Year's celebration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Senior year brought grand challenges—yet the start of the new year was as calm as a tranquil sea.
